name: Task Savant (General)
body:
“Give me a moment and I can do it.”

Prerequisite(s): Moment of change class feature.

Benefit(s): You can spend 1 moment of change to exchange one Str or Dex based chosen class skill for another Str or Dex based chosen class skill. Special: You can take this feat as a shaped capacity so long as you meet its prerequisites.
